settings.hero_desc: A detailed city development scale model - buildings, roads, vehicles and landscaping reproduced to scale on a presentation base. Built to headline exhibition stands and sales galleries, it lets visitors take in an entire development at a glance.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your city/development, branding, scale and LED lighting
settings.s1_body: This city model brings a development to life in three dimensions - streets, blocks, cars and greenery, all to scale and finished to exhibition standard. We built this one to headline a stand at GITEX, where crowds gathered around it; the same model works just as well in a sales gallery or reception. Give us your city or masterplan and we reproduce it, right down to the road layout and landmark buildings.
settings.case_body: Built for Dubai AI to demonstrate their disaster detection software using a city scaled model, this city model in GITEX drew a steady crowd - a tangible, detailed development that visitors could walk around and understand far faster than any screen. It even drew media attention and became a highlight in the newspaper.
settings.case_quote: Thanks to this model, more people visited our exhibition booth. Everyone wanted to see the city up close.
settings.prov_p: GITEX is a competitive Technology Exhibition in UAE every year. Having a scale model gives you a competitive edge and differentiate your booth compared to other participants. Leading to more visitor footfall and visibility for your project.
